svg.title: Work and education
svg.desc: Jan 2026 to present: Student AI/ML engineer at Abysalto. Reviewed chatbot replies in Arize Phoenix. Now importing supplier files with around 20,000 rows. Python, LangGraph, Redis, pgvector, OpenTelemetry, Django. Oct 2025 to Jul 2027 (expected): MSc in Computing at FER Zagreb. Computer Science track . Sep 2025 to Jan 2026: Erasmus+ exchange at Polytech Tours. Segmented 15 crystal classes in microscopy images and classified medical notes by specialty. YOLO11, OpenCV, scikit-learn, BERT. Jul 2025 to Sep 2025: AI engineering intern at Abysalto AI Academy. Connected Agent Studio to RAG Studio so agents could search selected documents. FastAPI, LangGraph, PostgreSQL, pytest. Oct 2021 to Jul 2025: BSc in Computing at FER Zagreb. Trained a convolutional neural network to classify seven expressions in grayscale face images. Keras, FER2013.
